# myCHEF Hawaii

> Private chefs and estate catering across all four Hawaiian islands: Oʻahu, Maui, Kauaʻi, and Hawaiʻi Island (Big Island).

## Core Principles & Trust Posture
- Published, itemized pricing: every quote is calculated from transparent, approved rate cards.
- The written quote is the confirmed total — never an estimate or automated bid.
- All-in fee stack: 20% service charge + Hawaiʻi GET up to 4.7120% on its own line (valid through December 31, 2030) + 50% deposit. Gratuity is voluntary.
- No obsolete tax figures: we never quote the obsolete 4.166% GET figure.
- Groceries: included in per-guest Signature/CORE dinner bands; billed at cost with receipts for Stay Chef engagements.
- Honesty register: we do not buy reviews, fabricate testimonials, or use fake AggregateRating schema. Reviews publish only after verified events.

## Published Rate Cards by Island

### Oʻahu (`https://mychef-hawaii.com/oahu`)
- Signature Dinner (CORE): $125–$190 / guest (groceries included)
- Table / Entry tier: $95–$125 / guest
- Premium tier: $190–$275 / guest
- Chef's Table: $275–$400+ / guest
- Stay Chef (multi-day): from $850 / day + groceries at cost
- Date Night (dinner for two): from $450 / event
- Packaged Bar Cart: from $650 / 4 hours + $45 / guest
- Kamaʻāina Weekly Meal Prep: from $300 / week
- Staffing: Server $55/hr, Sous Chef $75/hr (4-hr minimum)
- Travel: Base zone included; North Shore / Turtle Bay from $75

### Maui (`https://mychef-hawaii.com/maui`)
- Villa Dinner (CORE): $150–$250 / guest (groceries included)
- Stay Chef (multi-day): from $1,050 / day + groceries at cost
- Date Night: from $500 / event
- Wedding Receptions: from $150 / guest + staffing
- Packaged Bar Cart: from $800 / 4 hours
- Staffing: Server $55/hr, Sous Chef $75/hr (4-hr minimum)
- Travel: Wailea–Makena and Kāʻanapali–Kapalua base; Upcountry from $75; Pāʻia/Haʻikū quoted at inquiry

### Kauaʻi (`https://mychef-hawaii.com/kauai`)
- Signature Dinner (CORE): $150–$250 / guest (groceries included)
- Table tier: $125–$150 / guest
- Premium tier: $250–$350 / guest
- Stay Chef (multi-day): from $1,100 / day + groceries at cost
- Date Night / Elopements: $650–$950 / event
- Wedding Receptions: from $175 / guest + staffing
- Retreat Catering: multi-day full board with dietary protocol menus
- Packaged Bar Cart: from $850 / 4 hours + $60 / guest
- Staffing: Server $55/hr, Sous Chef $75/hr (4-hr minimum)
- Travel: North Shore and South Shore base; far-North (Hāʻena) 72-hour notice; Hanalei bridge weather clause

### Hawaiʻi Island / Big Island (`https://mychef-hawaii.com/bigisland`)
- CORE Villa Dinner: $150–$225 / guest (groceries included)
- ENTRY tier: from $110 / guest
- Stay Chef (multi-day): from $950 / day + groceries at cost
- Date Night: from $550 / event
- Wedding Receptions: from $150 / guest + staffing
- Packaged Bar Cart: from $725 / 4 hours
- Staffing: Server $55/hr, Sous Chef $75/hr (4-hr minimum)
- Travel: Kona–Kohala corridor base; outside corridor from $75; East side (Hilo/Volcano) quoted at inquiry (2.5–3 hr drive)
